PRF-1.name: Heliocentric On-Ball Engine
PRF-1.signals: USG%, TS%, AST%, potential assists, TOV%, On/Off Net
PRF-1.threshold: USG ≥ 30%; ≥40% of team possessions through this player

PRF-10.name: POA Stopper
PRF-10.signals: Screen-nav rate, blow-by allowed, matchup difficulty
PRF-10.threshold: ≥35% defensive possessions vs primary creators; containment rated

PRF-11.name: Wing Stopper / Switch Defender
PRF-11.signals: Switch success, iso eff. allowed, deflections

PRF-12.name: Rebounding / Possession Specialist
PRF-12.threshold: OREB% ≥10% or DREB% ≥25% with elite contested rate

PRF-13.name: Transition Weapon
PRF-13.threshold: Transition freq ≥20% of possessions; pts per trans ≥1.2

PRF-14.name: Bench Microwave Scorer
PRF-14.threshold: Bench USG ≥22%; shot volatility above team mean

PRF-2.name: Primary On-Ball Creator (non-helio)
PRF-2.signals: USG, drives, AST%, rim freq, FTr
PRF-2.threshold: USG 25-30%; secondary engine; can lead lineups

PRF-5.name: Slasher / Rim Pressure Wing
PRF-5.signals: Drives, pts per drive, rim eFG, FTr

PRF-7.name: Roll-Man / Screen-Setter Big
PRF-7.signals: Screen assists, pts per roll, rim FG%

PRF-9.name: Rim Protector Anchor
PRF-9.signals: Opp rim FG% on contest, deterrence model, rim freq when on
PRF-9.threshold: Block% ≥4%; rim deterrence visible in opponent shot location

M-1.name: Elite Gravity
M-1.notes: Star-level skill draws coverage and warps spacing
M-1.threshold: Face-guard rate >25% in tracking; coverage distortion measurable

M-10.name: Elite Rim Deterrence
M-10.notes: Distinct from M-3; affects opponent shot selection
M-10.threshold: Opp rim freq when on -8pp vs team baseline

M-15.name: Elite Transition Decision-Maker
M-15.threshold: Trans assist rate top-decile; low trans TOV

M-16.name: Elite Clutch Process
M-16.threshold: Late-clock eFG above expected; decision quality (NOT raw splits)

M-17.name: High Variance / Streak Profile
M-17.threshold: σ(per-game pts) above team mean by 1+ stddev

M-19.name: Injury-Managed / Load-Sensitive
M-19.threshold: Documented health flag; minutes-managed entering series

M-2.name: Elite Foul Drawer
M-2.notes: Pace-neutral but inflates totals; clutch impact

M-22.name: Specialist: End-of-Clock Bailout
M-22.threshold: Shot creation under duress; track record

M-24.name: Specialist: Foul Management (No-Foul Defender)
M-24.threshold: Foul rate ≤2.5/36 while guarding top creators

M-28.name: Specialist: Jumbo Creator (oversized initiator)
M-28.threshold: Initiates offense at ≥6'8" with PG-level USG

M-30.name: Specialist: One-Side Player (offense-only / defense-only)
M-30.threshold: Documented impact on one end vastly exceeds the other

M-31.name: Specialist: Late-Career Athletic Decline (compensation IQ)
M-31.threshold: 32+ age; relies on IQ over athleticism

M-32.name: Specialist: Rookie Processing Volatility
M-32.threshold: First-year; high variance in decision quality

M-6.name: Elite Passing Vision
M-6.threshold: AST% ≥25% with low live-ball TOV; advanced reads

M-7.name: Elite Handle / Pressure Release
M-7.threshold: Iso success rate vs blitz top-decile

M-8.name: Elite Screen Navigator (chaser)
M-8.threshold: Top-10% screen-nav success on top-of-key actions
